purpose: Design document for the /forge:start-implement skill: responsibilities, behaviors, contracts and algorithms that realize REQ-034 for executing plan tasks, reviewing, and managing state.
summary: Scope and premises: realizes REQ-034 requirements, introduces the task execution unit, and excludes plan creation
Scenario table SC-01 to SC-27 mapping requirements to triggers and responses
Responsibility classes and class diagram: orchestrator, startup check, task selection, state transition, plan check, context creation, executor agent, result check, review request
Sequence diagrams for startup, preparation and implementation, task completion, task group completion, error and rerun, and post-completion flow
Contracts: shared data definitions, per-module tables with preconditions and postconditions, and AI output promises
Detailed design: means and placement, JSON data structures (task context, selection result, startup state), state transition rules, selection algorithm
Algorithms for required reading collection, scope derivation, result inspection, review invocation, final verification, and parallel independence check
Operating principles: plan file as single source of truth, atomic replacement writes, dependent implemented tasks reverted on failure
Executor agent edit scope rationale, testing policy, and a traceability table from REQ-034 to design elements
tasks: Implementing the start-implement skill and its scripts
Writing or modifying the executor agent definition
Implementing task selection and plan state transitions
Designing or reviewing the context creation and result inspection scripts
Creating an implementation strategy document for start-implement
title: DES-088 start-implement 設計書
